title: H12 broad-bear-regime short Donchian trend screen
purpose: Test one economically motivated H11 revision: permit the unchanged short breakout only during a causal broad bear regime. A pass permits forward paper validation only.
selection_disclosure: H12 was selected after observing H10 and H11 on this same interval. Repeated reuse materially increases overfitting risk; results are not independent out-of-sample evidence.

data.type: 5m contract klines aggregated to UTC-aligned 4h bars
data.quality_policy: Reuse only HY-EXP-0015 files whose hashes pass its locked manifest; reject duplicate, non-contiguous, incomplete or misaligned bars.

regime.definition: At the completed signal bar, BTCUSDT 60-bar SMA is strictly below its 180-bar SMA, BTCUSDT close is strictly below its 180-bar SMA, and at least four of the six symbols have closes strictly below their own 180-bar SMA. All SMAs include only bars completed by the signal time.

strategy.entry: When the broad bear regime is true and a completed symbol 4h close is strictly below its prior 120-bar low, sell at the next 4h open. Long signals are ignored.
strategy.exit: Exit at the next 4h open after a completed close is strictly above the prior 60-bar high, or at the fixed initial two-ATR intrabar stop, whichever occurs first. Regime changes do not force an exit.
strategy.conflict_policy: While open, no new entry or reversal is allowed. Intrabar stop takes precedence over a later close-based channel exit.
strategy.terminal_exit: Liquidate any open position at the close of the last complete 4h bar before the evaluation boundary and charge one exit fill.
strategy.position_policy: At most one short per symbol; no pyramiding; fixed one-sixth account allocation per symbol; idle slots earn zero; no compounding.
strategy.funding: Omitted because the public kline screen lacks a causal funding ledger; report this limitation.

accounting.trade_metrics: Win rate and profit factor use each closed position's stressed return on its symbol slot.
accounting.portfolio_metrics: Net return and drawdown scale each trade by one-sixth account allocation; closed-equity drawdown is ordered by exit time and excludes intratrade mark-to-market drawdown.
accounting.monthly_metrics: Attribute one-sixth-scaled stressed return to UTC exit month and include every calendar month touched by the interval.
accounting.half_period_metrics: First half contains exits before 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z; second half contains exits at or after that timestamp.

decision.pass: Eligible for a newly frozen forward paper-validation clock; never immediate live replacement.
decision.fail: Eliminate this exact H12 specification. Stop repeated tuning on the same year before defining any H13.
decision.change_policy: Any feature, threshold, channel, stop, direction, cost, universe or date change requires a new experiment id.
